outline: This course aims to develop students' English language skills and communicative competence for effective communication. Centered around the fields of science, technology and engineering, the materials and activities in the course are designed to prepare students to understand and discuss the topics of the fields.

flexible_learning.content:
Week 17: Students independently compile a discipline-specific vocabulary learning record. They select and study words or terms relevant to their field of study.

Week 18: Students complete an individual reflection on their current vocabulary-learning practices, difficulties in learning technical vocabulary, and strategies they may adopt in future learning.

This is an English for Specific/Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All textbooks, teaching materials, handouts, and presentation slides are in English. English is used for at least 90% of classroom instruction and teacher–student interaction.
本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例90% (含)以上。
